changelog: Adds YouTube, Rumble and Both video source selection in the new Rumble + Bunny sync TV settings panel
Includes a sidebar for locally followed Rumble channels and phone-to-TV pairing with a 10-digit code
Uses direct HLS/MP4 playback with alternate stream fallback for Rumble videos
Bunny server and Rumble API activation are required before cloud sync or Rumble discovery works
Preserves SmartTube YouTube playback, rollback recovery, signed updates and Google TV Streamer-compatible ARMv7/Universal APKs
Adds YouTube, Rumble and Both to the main TV sidebar
Shows Rumble alongside YouTube on Home in Both mode
Uses followed Rumble channels or live videos when you have no follows
Requests Android media audio focus for Rumble playback
Adds Follow on Rumble to the YouTube player controls
Choose a matching Rumble channel to save it to your synced SmartTube follows
Home shows recent videos from YouTube subscriptions and followed Rumble channels, newest first where dates are available
Rumble cards show the channel name and upload date when available
Both mixes YouTube and matching Rumble videos in each category, including creators you do not follow
